original_test_intent: Verify the Version field of the intended SMBIOS Type 2 BaseBoard record equals the approved hardware/PCB revision and persists after reboot, without substituting BIOS or system version.
original_method: Archive all Type 2 records, select the target baseboard by product/serial/location/BOM, extract its Version, compare with board revision records, run the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the board record/revision mapping and plan. Collection, record-scoped comparison and reboot are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve all Type 2 records/errors and do not assume the first Version is the target.
Do not substitute Type 0 BIOS Version, Type 1 system Version or firmware revision.
Stop on ambiguous board selection, BOM mismatch, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 2/tool/BOM evidence, select the approved board record and compare its Version before/after reboot.
Do not alter DMI, guess record mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve board/BOM record mapping, revision semantics and expected value.
Resolve PCB/assembly revision differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Type 2 is correct, but unscoped grep may conflate multiple board records and hides errors; insecure transport assumptions are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 2 plus tool version/errors and select the target record using correlated fields before extracting Version.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 2 script, Version scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each Type 2 record to BOM/location and compare the selected board Version with the approved PCB/assembly revision, retaining all records across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2 systems, including multi-board inventories.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved baseboard/BOM revision recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target-record selection and separates hardware revision from firmware/system versions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target board mapping and revision semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PCB, assembly and marketing revision strings may differ; the project recipe must define the expected Type 2 representation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a named PCB/assembly revision format for a specific board record. It must state the target record/BOM.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected board Version, record/BOM mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot all-Type-2 records plus selected revision
